Partial northward shelf-break West Greenland59.4–67N editorial Cape Farewell-approach to Davis-Strait gate. Exclude inshore WGCC, westward bifurcation into Labrador Sea, detached Irminger Rings, fjords, upstream EGC/Irminger and onward Baffin continuation as target identities. Surface Arctic and deeper Atlantic waters may share sign; velocity-connected span does not partition water masses. Source top50m averaging and500m pathway isobath are not whole-current thickness. Broad maxima can be coastal or other-branch flow; no independent branch/axis identity is claimed.

Partial Malvinas/Falkland Argentine-margin49–41S reach upstream of the Brazil–Malvinas confluence. Inshore/main branches,detached along-slope cores and eddies can compete inside broad gates; the selected integral maximum does not independently assign a coherent main branch. Northward component is a fixed diagnostic rather than a locally rotated along-slope vector. Exclude upstream Drake/Burdwood ACC partition,Brazil Current,confluence recirculation and detached eddies as target identities. Frey2021 local core depths,nominal700m instrument range and Cainzos2023 inverse transport-layer extent remain distinct observations/definitions,not imposed bottoms or validation of these2022 snapshots.

method: Frozen unique paired finite depth contours and linear transverse strips between original consecutive native longitude columns only; native-supported first-to-last contiguous model depth span retained even where boundaries are censored.
minimum_span_interpretation: Minimum support is conditional on the original contiguous piecewise-linear signed-component model definition. It is not a physical named-current thickness bound. A single supported level gives zero minimum support, not zero thickness or flow absence.
range_interpretation: Sampling-bracket geometry scenarios, not confidence intervals, physical uncertainty, annual envelopes or guaranteed true-area bounds.
axis_anchor_interpretation: Discrete original model-selected axis proxies only; five unresolved source cases retain null anchors and original candidate diagnoses. No between-section interpolation, stronger replacement core, current identity promotion or volume.
interpretation: Partial regional model-component depth shapes at original0.1m/s; areas from different cuts/dates/owners are not additive water volume. Missing support stays unknown.
source_credit: HYCOM Consortium,NRL,COAPS-FSU; original source methods,owners and branch scope retained.
run_note: Inclusive component-thickness lower support under original contiguous piecewise-linear model definition; single-level zero is an uninformative bound, not absence.
